# Public API of Blacklight Engine, generated by `pnpm api:check --update` from the declarations
# of every entry point (scripts/api-entries.mjs). A changed line is a change of the public API:
# a removed or narrowed line breaks games (major version), an added one is a feature (minor).

## @blacklight/core

class AnchorToScreen extends Behavior<AnchorOptions>
  readonly name: "anchorToScreen"
  readonly ownsMovement: true
  update(object: GameObject): void
class AnimatedSprite extends Sprite

abstract class Behavior<Options extends object = object, O extends GameObject = GameObject>
  constructor(options: Options)
  enabled: boolean
  abstract readonly name: string
  object: O
  readonly options: Options
  readonly ownsMovement: boolean
  attach(object: O): void
  detach(_object: O): void
  update(_object: O, _dt: number): void

  static size: { height: number; width: number } | undefined

  readonly timers: Timers

  get bounds(): Rect

  get ui(): SceneUi
  get width(): number

  after(ms: number, callback: () => void): Unsubscribe
  byId(id: number): GameObject | undefined
  closeHosted(scene: Scene<never>): void
  create(_params: P): void | Promise<void>
  destroy(): void
  every(ms: number, callback: () => void): Unsubscribe
  find<T extends GameObject = GameObject>(what: string | string & {} | (...args: never[]) => T): T | undefined
  findAll<T extends GameObject = GameObject>(what: string | string & {} | (...args: never[]) => T): T[]
  goto(name: string, params?: unknown, options?: GotoOptions): Promise<void>
  hostScene(name: string, rect: Rect, params?: unknown): Promise<Scene<never>>

  listen<E extends object, K extends string | number | symbol>(bus: EventBus<E>, name: K, listener: (payload: E[K]) => void): Unsubscribe

interface AnchorOptions
  offset?: { x: number; y: number }
  x: number
  y: number
interface AnimationDef
  events?: Record<string, string | string[]>
  fps?: number
  frameOverrides?: Record<string, FrameOverride>
  frames?: string | number[] | { from: number; to: number }
  hitbox?: HitboxSpec
  loop?: boolean
  next?: string
  pingPong?: boolean
  pivot?: Point
  reverse?: boolean
interface AnimationFile
  $schema?: string
  animations: Record<string, AnimationDef>

class SchemaError extends Error
  constructor(issues: string[])
  readonly issues: string[]
interface NumberOptions
  integer?: boolean
  max?: number
  min?: number
interface Schema<Out, In = Out>
  readonly description: string
  check(value: unknown, path: string, issues: string[]): Out
  default(value: Out): Schema<Out, In | undefined>
  optional(): Schema<Out | undefined, In | undefined>
  parse(value: unknown, path?: string): Out
interface StringOptions
  max?: number
  min?: number
  pattern?: RegExp
  url?: boolean
type Infer<S> = S extends Schema<infer Out, unknown> ? Out : never
type InferInput<S> = S extends Schema<unknown, infer In> ? In : never
type ObjectInput<S extends Shape> = Simplify<{ [K in Exclude<keyof S, OptionalKeys<S>>]: InferInput<S[K]> } & { [K in OptionalKeys<S>]?: InferInput<S[K]> }>
type ObjectOutput<S extends Shape> = Simplify<{ [K in keyof S]: Infer<S[K]> }>
const t: { array<Out, In>(item: Schema<Out, In>, options?: { max?: number }): Schema<Out[], In[]>; boolean(): Schema<boolean>; bytes(): Schema<Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>>; enum<const V extends readonly (string | number)[]>(values: V): Schema<V[number]>; number(options?: NumberOptions): Schema<number>; object<S extends Shape>(shape: S): Schema<{ [K in string | number | symbol]: { [K in string | number | symbol]: Infer<S[K]> }[K] }, { [K in string | number | symbol]: { [K in string | number | symbol]: InferInput<S[K]> } & { [K in string | number | symbol]?: InferInput<S[K]> }[K] }>; record<Out, In>(value: Schema<Out, In>): Schema<Record<string, Out>, Record<string, In>>; string(options?: StringOptions): Schema<string>; unknown(): Schema<unknown> }

## @blacklight/native/define-native

interface AnyNativeFunction
  readonly args: readonly ArgSchema<unknown>[]
  run(context: NativeContext, ...args: never[]): unknown
interface ArgSchema<T>
  readonly description: string
  check(value: unknown, path: string, issues: string[]): T
interface NativeContext
  readonly dataDir: string
  readonly dev: boolean
  readonly gameId: string
interface NativeFunction<Args extends unknown[] = unknown[], Result = unknown>
  readonly args: { [K in string | number | symbol]: ArgSchema<Args[K]> }
  run(context: NativeContext, ...args: Args): Result | Promise<Result>
interface NativeModule<Name extends string = string, Functions extends Record<string, AnyNativeFunction> = Record<string, AnyNativeFunction>>
  readonly blacklightNative: true
  readonly functions: Functions
  readonly methods: readonly string[]
  readonly name: Name
  call(method: string, args: unknown[], context: NativeContext): Promise<unknown>
  dispose?(context: NativeContext): void | Promise<void>
  setup?(context: NativeContext): void | Promise<void>
interface NativeOptions<Name extends string, Functions>
  functions: Functions
  name: Name
  dispose?(context: NativeContext): void | Promise<void>
  setup?(context: NativeContext): void | Promise<void>
function defineNative<Name extends string, Functions extends Record<string, AnyNativeFunction>>(options: NativeOptions<Name, Functions>): NativeModule<Name, Functions>
function fn<const S extends readonly ArgSchema<unknown>[], Result>(args: S, run: (context: NativeContext, ...args: ArgsOf<S>) => Result | Promise<Result>): NativeFunction<ArgsOf<S>, Result>
function isNativeModule(value: unknown): value is NativeModule<string, Record<string, AnyNativeFunction>>
